imageSource: Existing EPF website portfolio photo; no claim of a new or neighbourhood-specific project.
expectedSummary:
Repainting your home? Plan popcorn ceiling removal in Mississauga before the final wall coats.

For homeowners in Port Credit and Mineola, coordinating ceiling work with a room refresh helps keep newly painted walls out of the preparation stage. EPF Pro Services can assess the existing texture, repairs and finish requirements before agreeing on the scope.

The work may include surface protection, suitable texture removal or encapsulation, drywall repairs, skim coating, HEPA-assisted sanding and primer. Ceiling painting can be included in the estimate. Reviewing the sequence early helps coordinate the work and gives you a clear plan for the finished room.

Send ceiling photos and approximate room sizes to request an estimate through our Mississauga service page.
